envelope.description: Carry the declared documents on the tool-call event (Claude)

body.title: Carry the declared documents on the tool-call event (Claude)
body.summary: Add the optional live-only present list to the tool-call TurnEvent in stream-events.ts and set it in the Claude mapper from the tool_use input's documents when the tool is insrc_present (an array of at most twenty non-empty strings; anything else leaves it absent). Every other tool-call event is unchanged and the field is never written to the saved transcript.
acceptanceChecks: A Claude insrc_present tool_use sets present from its input and every other tool leaves it off
An input that is not a list of at most twenty non-empty strings leaves present absent
present is not written into the saved transcript

tests.name: the Claude mapper sets present on an insrc_present tool call from its input and leaves it off every other tool call
an input that is not a list of at most twenty non-empty strings leaves present absent
the declared list is not written into the saved transcript
